lessons.text: To check for duplicate vendors in the ERP, call GET /vendors?q=<legal_name> and GET /vendors?q=<gstin>; if both return empty, it is safe to proceed with creation.

To create a vendor as Pending verification, log in at http://127.0.0.1:8765/erp, open /erp/vendors/new, fill Legal name, Accounts contact email, Email domain, GSTIN, Bank account number, and IFSC, then click Create vendor.

The ERP GUI session can expire between opening /erp/vendors/new and submitting, causing HTTP 500 on Create vendor; if this occurs, re-open /erp/vendors/new, re-login if redirected to /erp/login, and resubmit the form.
The ERP vendor creation form uses field labels 'Legal name', 'Accounts contact email', 'Email domain', 'GSTIN', 'Bank account number', and 'IFSC' for mandatory vendor data.
Procurement notification for a vendor awaiting verification should be sent to procurement@kestrel.in (internal address, no external-email approval required).
